title: The Login Code
intro: Your phone buzzes with a Zelvora login code you did not request.
Right after it, a text arrives from "Zelvora Security".
You can answer. Pick your replies and sniff each message.

notify.text: Sorry, we sent you a code by mistake…

screen.context: A real Zelvora code arrived 30 seconds ago, and you did not ask for it.

msg.text: Hi, we sent you a login code by mistake.

msg: Please read it back to us so we can cancel it.

replies.text: Who is this, and why do you need it?

msg.text: It is only so we can cancel it.
Otherwise your account will be locked in 5 minutes.

replies.text: I will open the Zelvora app and look myself
No real security team needs my code. Reporting

mistake.label: "Sent by mistake"
mistake.lens: Someone else just tried to sign in to your account, and the code is real.
mistake.why: The thief needs your code to get in. The story about a mistake is how they ask for it.

code.label: Asks for the code
code.lens: Reading it back gives the thief the key.
code.why: Anyone who asks for a login code is a scammer. No exception.

rush.label: Lock in 5 minutes
rush.why: Pressure is there to stop you from checking.

actions.label: Read the code back to them
Open the Zelvora app and check myself

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The thief tried the code and failed, and your account stayed yours.

verify.line: The app showed a sign-in attempt from another country, and you changed your password. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The code let the thief into your account. The coins left within minutes.

what_if.go_ahead: A login code is the last lock on your account. Nobody honest ever needs you to read it out.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Changing your password and reporting the number helps too.

golden_rule: Never read out a login code. Nobody real will ever ask you for it.

quick_check.q: A real login code arrives that you did not request, and a "security team" asks you to read it back. What do you do?

options.text: Read it back so they can cancel it
Never share it. Open the app, secure your account and report the number

quick_check.explain: A code you did not request means someone is trying to get in. Sharing it opens the door.

hints.nudge: Who needs your code besides you?

rows.v: Not the one Zelvora's codes come from
A login attempt just happened, not by you

rows.k: Staff will ask for your code
A code you did not ask for
rows.v: Means someone else tried to sign in. Secure your account
